_doc: Task 614 — WHERE DOES A BIB ENTRY END? Both Python silos answer this corpus: editor/scripts/bib_resolve.find_entry_span (editor/scripts/tests/test_bib_entry_span_parity.py) and library/scripts/_bib_parse.find_entry_span (library/scripts/tests/test_bib_entry_span_parity.py). `expect` is the verbatim entry text, null (no such entry), or "refuse" (the entry exists but its extent can't be trusted, so a splice must not happen).
